summary: Phase 53 · Stripe backend fully verified against LIVE Stripe. 17/18 tests passed, 1 skipped by design (STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET present — plan explicitly disallowed unsetting it). Health probe authenticates against Stripe. Checkout Session and PaymentIntent are created against live Stripe (pre-charge, no funds moved) and ledger rows persisted. Guardrails for already-paid invoice (400), cross-tenant (404), refund on non-existent/initiated/over-remaining, and missing-customer subscription (404) all pass. Webhook rejects invalid signature (400). Idempotency guard row insert path verified via db.stripe_events. Reconciliation feed exposes all required fields and rollup math (net = paid - refunded) is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: stripe_admin._handle_checkout_completed: calls get_stripe().PaymentIntent.retrieve(pi_id) twice in the same expression to build payload. Redundant network call; refactor to a single retrieve, then convert.

stripe_payments.create_checkout_session: idempotency_key uses inv.amount_paid which can be a float — non-deterministic key stringification across float precision. Consider rounding/formatting deterministically (e.g., int cents).

stripe_admin.stripe_webhook: when webhook secret is missing it returns 200 {mocked:true} — good for dev, but ensure production alerting fires if this path is ever taken with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET expected to be set.

stripe_payments.list_payments rollup is computed only over the paginated `rows` slice (limit=100) rather than the full collection — rollup will under-report as ledger grows past 100 rows per tenant. Consider a $group aggregation for accurate totals.
seed_data_creation: Session-scoped fixtures inserted 1 TEST_ paid invoice (quotes.id starts with TEST-PAID-) and 1 TEST_ paid ledger row (stripe_payments.id starts with TEST-LEDGER-). Both cleaned up in fixture teardown. 2 stripe_payments rows (kind=checkout + kind=payment_intent, status=initiated) intentionally left in aquaterra tenant per test-plan directive (pre-charge, no funds moved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 53 Stripe test file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_phase53_stripe.py — safe to re-run against live keys, pre-charge only. Ledger rows added per run: 2 (checkout + PI). If /stripe/health starts reporting key_authenticates=false, the fallback contract is {mocked:true,reason:'stripe_error',error_type:'AuthenticationError'} — not a defect. STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET must remain set; the mocked-fallback branch was verified by code review only.
